image_description: A low-angle shot of a large pipe organ situated within an ornate, organic-architecture style interior (resembling Gaudí's Sagrada Família). The organ features multiple groups of vertical metallic pipes of varying heights, arranged in stepped clusters. The background shows complex, branching stone columns and stained glass windows allowing natural light to filter through. The organ case appears dark and carved, blending with the architectural surroundings.
